annotations.title: List, edit, pause or detach Google Ads assets

description: The assets on a Google Ads campaign, ad group or the whole account (level:"customer"): action "list" (every attached asset with its review status and any policy problem), "update" (edit a sitelink/callout/snippet/call/promotion/price/lead-form asset — pass assetId, assetType and asset{} in add_google_ads_assets' shape), "pause", "enable" or "unlink" (pass assetId + fieldType from list). Google never deletes an asset; unlink stops it showing. Editing or re-enabling on a LIVE campaign needs confirm:true after the user agrees.

adGroupId.description: ad group id, when level is adGroup

assetId.description: asset id, from the list action

campaignId.description: campaign id, when level is campaign

confirm.description: true only after the user agreed to change a LIVE campaign's assets

customerId.description: 10-digit account id; omit to use the brand's selected default account

dryRun.description: true = validate with Google and change nothing

fieldType.description: the link field type from list, e.g. CALL, SITELINK

level.description: campaign, adGroup or customer; follows the id you pass

loginCustomerId.description: manager (MCC) account id when acting through a manager account; omit otherwise

name: manage_google_ads_assets
